blocks.text: It does not ask for the sign-in secret of your bank site.
The host in the header is the shop you opened. The tag on Buckwheat groats, 24 oz matches the amount due.
No sleeve is ticked. No repeat parcel is marked.
Ordinary ground carrier cost is already inside the tag.
You are paying Marigold at www.marigold.example.
The form wants the digits on the plastic, the month and year, and the short code on the back.
